etymologies.etymologyHTML: From Latin tribālis. By surface analysis, tribe +‎ -al, first attested in the 1630s.

definitions.definition: Based on or organized according to tribes.
A design or image that has been influenced by indigenous peoples; especially such a tattoo.

quote.citation: 1983, Human Science: Journal of the Anthropological Survey of India, page 141:
quote.text: This right had been accepted by relative tribals but misobeyed and effaced by non-tribals and foreign peasants.

quote.citation: 2018, Vaijayanta Anand, Geeta Balakrishnan, Purnima George, Community Practices in India: Lessons from the Grassroots, page 66:
quote.text: […]  the legendary Adivasi leader Jaipal Singh Munda who came to represent the tribals not just of his native plateau, but also of all of India  […]
